description: This PHP source file defines the class `SugarFieldEmailBody`, a custom field class for handling email body content in a SuiteCRM module. It provides methods to generate HTML for different views (detail, edit, search) while sanitizing the content, and includes utility functions for retrieving default values.

classes.name: SugarFieldEmailBody
classes.description: A custom field class extending SugarFieldBase, responsible for processing and rendering email body content in various views with HTML sanitization.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates HTML for the detail view of the email body, sanitizing the content before rendering.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates HTML for the edit view of the email body, sanitizing the content before rendering.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Generates HTML for the search view of the email body, sanitizing the content before rendering.

methods.name: getVardefValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a vardef, falling back to defaults if none is set, and converts encoding to ISO-8859-1.
